blocks.content:
According to Article 1, the territory of India includes:
• States
• Union Territories
• Any territory that may be acquired in the future
Always verify before exams in case of reorganization.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 1 defines the territory of India into three categories: States, Union Territories, and territories that may be acquired in the future.
India can acquire foreign territory through conquest, purchase, treaty, cession, or lease.
The current political structure consists of 28 States and 8 Union Territories.
Ladakh is the latest Union Territory created in 2019.

✔ 28 States
✔ 8 Union Territories
